steps.js: const i=[...document.querySelectorAll("input[placeholder*='Zip']")].find(e=>e.offsetWidth); if(!i) throw new Error('no input'); i.focus(); i.select&&i.select(); document.execCommand('insertText',false,'{{store_zip}}'); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise(x=>setTimeout(x,800)); i.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',code:'Enter',keyCode:13,bubbles:true})); return 'typed'

async function waitFor(f,n){for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const r=f(); if(r) return r; await new Promise(x=>setTimeout(x,1000));} return null;}; const vis=e=>e&&(e.offsetWidth||e.offsetHeight); const byText=(re,sel)=>[...document.querySelectorAll(sel||'button,a,[role=button],span,div')].filter(e=>vis(e)&&e.childElementCount<3&&re.test((e.innerText||'').trim())).pop();const b=await waitFor(()=>byText(/^Select$/),25); if(!b) throw new Error('no Select: '+document.body.innerText.slice(0,200)); b.click(); return 'selected'
